paper.title: Pyrolysis Kinetic Properties of Thermal Insulation Waste Extruded Polystyrene by Multiple Thermal Analysis Methods

source.separateDatasetLicenseReason: No separate machine-readable dataset or raw-curve supplement is locally available.

extraction.reportedQuantity: DTG peak temperature for one XPS pyrolysis peak at each heating rate
extraction.transcriptionRule: Pair the five heating rates listed for the experiment with the five peak temperatures reported in the same order.

peakEvidenceContract.basis: The article describes and labels one XPS DTG peak at each rate; the curated fixture records an analyst-confirmed transcription, not an independent raw-curve peak re-evaluation.

scientificBoundaries: The rows are a transcription of values printed in the article, not instrument-exported TGA or DTG curves.
The fixture cannot validate alpha-dependent FWO, KAS, Starink, or Friedman calculations.
The calculated Kissinger result is conditional on peak temperatures rounded to whole kelvin in the publication.
The article reports a single DTG peak for each rate, but this fixture does not establish universal one-step kinetics.
